repair.diagnosis: The fixed sticky-promo bar overlays and intercepts pointer events for the fixed Add to Cart button
repair.evidenceSummary: Screenshot shows the bottom promo bar with no visible Add to Cart button; probes at mobile, small, and desktop show #add-to-cart is inViewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement #sticky-promo, and the real pointer purchase fails. In styles.css the button sits at bottom:16px with z-index:10 while the 84px-high promo sits at bottom:0 with z-index:20, fully covering the button's 52px height.
repair.rationale: Moving the button 100px from the bottom places it 16px above the 84px-high sticky promo without removing or hiding either element, so it becomes visible and pointer-hit-testable in all viewports.

parsed.rationale: Repair correctly addresses diagnosed overlay: #add-to-cart at bottom:16px z-index:10 was fully covered by 84px #sticky-promo at bottom:0 z-index:20 (hitIsSelf=false, hitElement #sticky-promo). Moving to bottom:100px places it 16px above promo, preserving both elements. Fixes 4/6 signals: interactive-usable@mobile/small/desktop and pointer-purchase-works:featured. Remaining 2 failures (cart-total-for-product, cart-total-matches-catalog-rules) are pre-existing and unrelated; no new regressions. deterministicProbePassAfter=false reflects those unrelated cart failures.

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the catalog price for nova-sneaker
repair.evidenceSummary: Catalog priceMinor is 8900 and screenshot shows $89.00, but probes show cart totals 7900 after 1 and 15800 after 2 (2x7900); app.js defines LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR=7900 and multiplies count by it
repair.rationale: Use product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG, the single source of truth, so 2 items total 17800 without hardcoding the catalog value

parsed.rationale: Repair correctly replaces stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG (8900). Evidence shows cart totals were 7900/15800 vs expected 8900/17800, and after fix probes pass with no failing signals. Change is minimal, uses source of truth without hardcoding.
